title: Elements 87-118: period 7, with the actinides
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Row seven finishes the table: radium and uranium, the actinides, and the heavy elements made in laboratories, the last of them named in 2016. Every element in this list is in period 7.

How to hold it: Many of these names honor places and people (americium, californium, einsteinium, curium, nobelium), so build a picture for each: a map pin, a portrait, a city skyline. The actinides run in the same order as the lanthanides above them, so learn them side by side. Chunks of five, reviewed on the 1-3-7-21 schedule, keep the long tail from slipping.
